version.mismatch: Frontend and backend versions differ; some features may be limited. Please update the backend or frontend and try again.

connection.lostDesc: Cannot reach the backend service. Check that the backend is still running; it will reconnect automatically.

platforms.title: Platform Management
platforms.codeHelp: Choose from registered messaging platforms to avoid typos and inaccurate judgments
platforms.noPlatforms: No platforms found. Create your first platform to get started.

adapters.title: Bridge Adapters
adapters.platformHelp: The adapter handles messages from the selected message platform (Xianyu/Taobao/WeChat etc.). Add instances under it after creation
adapters.runtimeHelp: Runtime environment for the adapter program: Python / Node.js / Go
adapters.noAdapters: No adapters found. Create your first adapter to get started.

instances.title: Instance Management
instances.adapterHelp: An instance is a concrete account/shop connection under an adapter. One adapter can have many instances (multi-instance)
instances.cookieHelp: Copy the full Cookie from browser dev tools after logging into Xianyu (independent per instance)
instances.noInstances: No instances found. Create your first instance to get started.
instances.initializingHint: Installing dependencies automatically; start will be enabled when ready
instances.subtitle: Manage adapter instances across platforms

adapterGateway.title: WebSocket Adapter
adapterGateway.subtitle: Create configurable WebSocket adapters with server/client modes, authenticated by an access key
adapterGateway.name: Name
adapterGateway.modeHelp: Server mode: this system listens on a WebSocket endpoint and external systems connect with the key. Client mode: this system actively connects to an external WebSocket URL with the key.
adapterGateway.listenPathHelp: Listen path for server mode; leave empty to use default /ws
adapterGateway.wsUrlHelp: External WebSocket URL to connect to in client mode, e.g. ws://host:port/path
adapterGateway.keyPlaceholder: Access key; click the button on the right to regenerate
adapterGateway.keyHelp: External systems must present this key to authenticate. It can be edited or regenerated anytime.
adapterGateway.platformHelp: Only receive messages from this platform; leave empty to receive all
adapterGateway.scopeHelp: read = receive messages only, write = send replies only, read+write = both
adapterGateway.noAdapters: No adapters yet. Click "New Server" or "New Client" in the top-right to create one.

routes.title: Route Rules
routes.priorityHelp: Higher number = higher priority, matched first
routes.noConditionsHint: No conditions (matches all messages). Click "Add condition" to filter.
routes.conditionsAndHint: Multiple conditions are combined with AND. A message must satisfy all of them to be routed.
routes.platformHelp: Only match messages from this platform; leave empty to match all
routes.targetTypeHelp: app = send to frontend app, webhook = send to external endpoint
routes.targetIdHelp: Target app ID or Webhook URL
routes.noRoutes: No routes found. Create your first route to get started.

eventTypes.message.delivered.desc: The message was successfully delivered to the recipient
eventTypes.message.failed.desc: Message sending failed, possibly due to network or account issues
eventTypes.adapter.connected.desc: The adapter successfully connected to the platform
eventTypes.adapter.disconnected.desc: The adapter lost connection to the platform
eventTypes.command.created.desc: The system created an outbound command
eventTypes.command.sent.desc: An outbound command was sent to the platform
eventTypes.command.failed.desc: An outbound command failed to execute
